headline: UN report reveals five women are k!lled every hour by partners or relatives
label: NEWS
caption:
Five women are k!lled every hour by an intimate partner or family member globally, according to new UN data. 🚨

A new report by UNODC and UN Women reveals that around 47,000 women and girls were intentionally k!lled by family members or partners last year. This accounts for nearly 60 percent of all femicides worldwide.

UN Women stated that home remains the most dangerous place for a woman or girl, describing it as a pattern that has barely shifted in years. On average, 129 women are k!lled every day by people close to them.

Africa recorded the highest rate with 2.9 victims per 100,000 women, followed by the Americas, Oceania, Asia, and Europe. UNODC Executive Director Monica Juma warned that institutional failures and societal norms create an environment where these k!llings become tolerable.

UN Women Executive Director Sima Bahous stressed that most victims never receive protection before it is too late. She urged governments to ensure women can report violence safely and access support.
